title: Gather Coins
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2\leq H,W \leq 2\times 10^5; 1\leq N \leq \min(HW-2, 2\times 10^5); 1\leq R_i \leq H; 1\leq C_i \leq W; (R_i,C_i)\neq (1,1); (R_i,C_i)\neq (H,W); (R_i,C_i) are pairwise distinct.; All input values are integers.
